title: Hyperion
description: A client modpack which brings Quality-Of-Life features and performance. Based on Fabulously Optimized.
body:
![View of a beautiful island with black oak trees and shaders enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/UfAquUNx/images/87263b04437778a4b4394fec8d598e3f21fe8f2e.png)

# Hyperion
Hyperion is a client modpack, which brings a performance boost and quality-of-life features. It is based on Fabulously Optimized.

# Features
Hyperion contains these features:
- **⚡ Optimization:** Hyperion contains optimization mods from FO, like Sodium and Lithium.
- **🏝️ Shaders:** Hyperion supports shaderpacks, thanks to Iris.
- **📨 Animated Hotbar:** Hyperion has animations for the tooltip, dropping and picking items up.
- **🌈 Rainbow Hitboxes:** It just looks cool.
- **🧼 Clean Titlescreen:** We moved and removed things from the titlescreen, so it looks much cleaner.
- **🎶 Improved sounds:** Hyperion has some extra soundeffects which vanilla doesn't have.
- **⚠️ No chat reports:** The chat reporting system is bad, so we added a mod that removes it where it's possible.
- **📜 Recipe viewer:** Hyperion contains JEI, which is a cool recipe viewer.
- **🎮 Controller support:** Hyperion supports controllers, using Controlify.
- **⚔️ Smart crosshair:** The crosshair in Hyperion automatically turns red if you look at a player.
- **🫂 Seamless Multiplayer:** Host your Singleplayer worlds via e4mc without Port Forwarding to your friends.
- **🌐 Resource downloader:** In-game resource downloader for resource packs, shaders, and worlds.
- **🔁 ReplayMod:** Hyperion has ReplayMod, which allows you to save your gameplay.
- **🗺️ JourneyMap:** Hyperion contains JourneyMap, which allows for really cool map and waypoints.
- **👴 Older servers:** We installed ViaFabricPlus, which allows you to join servers on older versions.
- And so much more!

# Disclaimer
⚠️ Use this modpack in multiplayer at your own risk.

# FAQ
>**Q:** Which mods does Hyperion have?
>
>**A:** Look at the newest version in the "Versions" tab.


>**Q:** Do I need Hyperion on the server to join?
>
>**A:** Nope, Hyperion can join vanilla servers.

>**Q:** How do I play with friends using e4mc?
>
>**A:** Open your Singleplayer world to LAN and inside the chat you will see an address, your friend must connect to that address like if it's a server.
